general.description: Free-running 8 ms window at 1 MS/s, +/-5 V. Signals up to ~100 kHz.

fast_edges.description: 82 us window at 100 MS/s, +/-5 V, must trigger at 1.5 V. Edges and ringing.

slow.description: 0.8 s window at 10 kS/s, +/-25 V. Rails, ripple, slow PWM.

uart_9600_8n1.description: UART 9600 baud 8N1 on one line (~20 bytes per capture).

uart_115200_8n1.description: UART 115200 baud 8N1 on one line (~90 bytes per capture).

pwm.description: PWM frequency and duty on one line, 16 ms window. 125 Hz to ~100 kHz.

i2c_100k.description: I2C standard mode: SCL and SDA on the two arms' logic probes.

i2c_400k.description: I2C fast mode: SCL and SDA on the two arms' logic probes.

spi_mode0.description: SPI mode 0, MSB first: SCK plus one data line (MOSI or MISO). Partial, no CS.
